facts: P17 acceptance limits are authored review thresholds, distinct from measured geometry and live tuning. ExpectedScenarioBounds derives every bound by scenario; terrain vertical limit propagates Measured/Unavailable/NotApplicable relief without defaulting absence to flat terrain. ExpectedVisualHeight owns one per-scenario range/peak definition.

P17 biomechanics/continuity/height/landing validators consume measured quantities and expected bounds separately, with explicit exceptions for ragdoll, posture, authored transitions and diagnostic cases. Missing required evidence fails rather than becoming zero; optional absent scenario selection is intentionally not applicable, pending report selection-completeness consumers.

P17 cadence gate uses canonical ordinary_step_distance for requested 2m/s and independently observes actual captured contact sequence, foot alternation and integrated root distance. Expected input is an oracle, not duplicate gameplay-state storage.

P17 body-response validation derives lean ranges from signed observations; empty unselected scenario is NotApplicable while missing value within selected frames is Unavailable. Straight-run lateral pose is compared as actual body-local displacement. Separate expected min/max thresholds do not constitute competing current pose authority.

P17 HTML derives data and measurements from manifest and preserves unavailable/not-applicable descriptions. Explicit quality denominator31 and fixed64Hz playback are presentation policy copies requiring comparison to quality-score/clock owners before any drift claim. Source review does not execute scripts or prove user-facing HTML acceptance.
